title: Smoked Polish Rye Pilaf Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish made with smoked polish sausage, rye bread, and a hint of smoked flavor.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the smoked polish sausage over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cubed rye bread to the skillet and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pilaf, cooked sausage mixture, and toasted rye bread.
Mix in the caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
